Italy is moving toward a new school policy under Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, including a proposed ban on burqas and niqabs, limits on foreign students in classrooms, and mandatory Italian lessons for some foreign parents.
The proposal comes as immigration, integration and national identity become increasingly contested issues on Italy’s political right. With a new challenger emerging further to Meloni’s right, the move could have implications far beyond the classroom.
Watch LIVE as Hem Kaur Saroya explains.
